scope: Development-only offline gate before collecting new scenes; no prior decision changes.
chord_rule: Only recover UNKNOWN when every sample has valid depth, no face code, a single contiguous four-or-more-sample through-depth interval, and unresolved rays only in two terminal runs each no longer than min(floor(chord/4),12). Every terminal ray must depth-connect within 12 four-neighbor steps to its own same-row bank via native same-side bank/cap rules and tolerance. Preserve the old two-dimensional and cross-row background connectivity, positive terminal boundary, and later opening veto. Do not repair a missing boundary or a partially cut row.
qualification: All historical guided_prefix_review exposures from all four archive reports, including non-permit frames. Recompute registered measured noise exactly and preserve every v3 known verdict. A recovered known verdict must equal the historical structural prefix at that capture tick. Confirm all synthetic negatives fail closed, plus one long supported shore positive, before any live case.
